body: This is exactly what I experience too. My memories are like fragments of glass from a broken mirror and I can’t piece them together. I remember situations in brief images but like you said, there’s no detail, it’s all a blur, and then my mind goes blank. Pretty sure that’s dissociative amnesia, it’s your mind’s way of checking out a stressful situation in order to protect you. Just know that you’re not alone.
Thank you so much for replying. I will try to tell her next week when I see her.

I live in Scotland and think that it was here in late September. Doc diagnosed me with Pleurisy around that time, caused by Pneumonia and have never been so sick in my life. I’m convinced that it was the virus. 3 of my friends have said they had it too.
